I didn't find a skill for class diagrams, so I built this from the production sources by hand. `PetClinicRuntimeHints` uses `RuntimeHints` and `ClassLoader` in its `registerHints` method. It registers reflection hints for `BaseEntity`, `Person` and `Vet`. The only class that uses it is `PetClinicApplication`, through `@ImportRuntimeHints`.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class PetClinicRuntimeHints {
        +registerHints(RuntimeHints hints, ClassLoader classLoader) void
    }

    class RuntimeHintsRegistrar {
        <<interface>>
        +registerHints(RuntimeHints hints, ClassLoader classLoader) void
    }

    class RuntimeHints {
        +resources() ResourceHints
        +reflection() ReflectionHints
    }

    class ClassLoader

    class PetClinicApplication {
        <<SpringBootApplication>>
        +main(String[] args)$ void
    }

    class BaseEntity {
        -Integer id
        +getId() Integer
        +setId(Integer id) void
        +isNew() boolean
    }

    class Person {
        -String firstName
        -String lastName
        +getFirstName() String
        +setFirstName(String firstName) void
        +getLastName() String
        +setLastName(String lastName) void
    }

    class Vet {
        -Set~Specialty~ specialties
        #getSpecialtiesInternal() Set~Specialty~
        +getSpecialties() List~Specialty~
        +getNrOfSpecialties() int
        +addSpecialty(Specialty specialty) void
    }

    RuntimeHintsRegistrar <|.. PetClinicRuntimeHints : implements
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> RuntimeHints : uses
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> ClassLoader : uses
    PetClinicApplication ..> PetClinicRuntimeHints : ImportRuntimeHints
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> BaseEntity : registers reflection hint
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> Person : registers reflection hint
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> Vet : registers reflection hint
    BaseEntity <|-- Person
    Person <|-- Vet
```
